description: Bounded sandbox-first scope split from T7-TTS-001. Execute the pinned Qwen3-TTS 12Hz 0.6B candidate on clay-direct-dev and measure model load, local inference, first generated audio/PCM availability, realtime factor, resource use, deterministic output identity and generation-cancellation behavior using an in-memory/file/null sink. The existing T7-TTS-001 COMPONENT_BENCHMARK remains authoritative for first-audible/heard-output/cancellation-to-silence S4 evidence.
